digest.component_or_area: binding store and GET rotation sidecar
propositions: Introduce a dedicated rotation module to manage GET-rotation sidecar load/save with fail-open semantics and read-max chronological value for each Jira key.
Dual-write every new rotation stamp to both the sidecar file and legacy inline field during rollout compatibility window.
Persist sidecar state only through BindingStore.save() paths covering end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, and retirement saves.
Stage and commit both dual-written rotation files in one local binding-store commit without git add -A.
Migrate legacy inline-only stores to equivalent sidecar state on first persisted save after initialization.
Interleaved old-binary and new-binary pass sequences must produce identical rotation order as all-new sequences.
